requirements.text: Require at least one mantissa digit and permit an optional leading sign.
Accept exactly the permitted decimal forms, with at most one decimal point.
Allow one optional e/E exponent containing a signed or unsigned integer.
Reject all other characters, missing components, and misplaced signs or separators.

reference_complexity.notes: Reference guidance, not an analysis of the submitted program. Include stored input, returned values, JSON serialization buffers, and recursion stacks in total space. Hash-table bounds, where stated, are expected rather than worst-case guarantees. Hard follows LeetCode; the 60-minute practice estimate is provisional.
